_note: Single source of truth for every weight, penalty and taxonomy entry. Scores change only if this file changes. Values marked 'assumed' were not stated in the architecture document and should be confirmed by the committee.

sentiment.insufficient_note: Below the minimum evidence standard sentiment reports Insufficient Data rather than a forced +1 or 0 (Reconciliation fix 6).
sentiment.aggregation_note: A 0 label means no signal; the mean is taken over non-zero events (confidence x recency weighted) so the rubric's +2 / -1 anchors are reachable. Falls back to the all-event mean below min_signal_events. +2 only with no material results-type offset in the window. Mirror rule for the -1 anchor: when the results-type evidence itself (prints, guidance) is negative on balance (its weighted mean <= results_dominance_threshold), sentiment is capped at -1 whatever the launches and broker notes say - 'material earnings deterioration dominates the year even if partial offsets exist'.

investigation: Unresolved probe active in the window.

Clean: No material adverse events in the 12-month window.
Watch: One or more disclosed items warranting monitoring; not integrity-level.
Flag: Live or recent event requiring IC-level attention before adding risk.

routine_types.management_change_routine: elevation, promotion, new appointment, planned retirement/succession, or an exit below CXO tier - not penalised
routine_types.rpt_routine: routine / approved / arm's-length related-party transaction - not penalised
routine_types.board_change_routine: ordinary board reconstitution or appointment with no independence gap - not penalised
routine_types.investigation_closed: probe concluded, quashed or cleared - not penalised (only a live probe is)
routine_types.auditor_rotation: scheduled auditor rotation / routine reappointment - not penalised

conventions._note: Conventions from the 1-Oct-2026 Reconciliation (section 7, fixes 2-3). They were never written down before, so a second implementer could not follow them.

subject_never_penalised.victim: the company is the victim (e.g. a bank defrauded by borrowers/appraisers)
subject_never_penalised.lender_or_counterparty: the event is about a lender / counterparty / customer
subject_never_penalised.peer_or_sector: sector or peer news (e.g. industry-wide rule tightening)
subject_never_penalised.macro_policy: macro or fiscal policy (e.g. a customs-duty hike)
subject_never_penalised.shareholders: an event about shareholders, not the company (e.g. KYC non-compliant holders)

conventions.materiality_floor_note: Sums below Rs 10 crore (or 0.1% of revenue) sit in the procedural band unless the matter is integrity-type (SEBI conduct, fraud, auditor integrity).
conventions.notice_without_order_note: A notice or demand with no order is a live overhang (-10), not a -20 order/settlement.
conventions.dedupe_note: The same real-world event reported on several days / as several types is ONE event: keep the most severe penalty.
conventions.resolved_never_penalised: A matter resolved or quashed in the company's favour is not a live overhang.

corporate_actions._note: Base values and multipliers are assumed; the document specifies only direction and materiality scaling.

dedupe.note: Repeat headlines of one declaration are ONE action (the July run counted 375 headlines incl. repeats).

sentiment_anchors: Sustained fundamental beats with broad confirming evidence (record earnings, upgraded guidance, favourable structural drivers) and no material offset in the lookback.
Positive year on balance, but with a specific offset — one weak quarter, an execution issue, or a valuation caution — that prevents the maximum score.
Genuinely two-sided: material positive drivers matched by material negative drivers, or coverage judged insufficient to score directionally.
Material earnings deterioration or a defined event whose economic impact dominates the year, even if partial offsets exist.

lint.note: Share-price moves never feed sentiment (Reconciliation fix 5). Price lives in the context overlay only.

universe.note: The universe is hashed and diffed against the last confirmed run; an unconfirmed change refuses to run (Reconciliation fix 4).

retrieval.note: Backdating a live search is not a point-in-time backtest (Reconciliation fix 1). Past as-of dates use the dated archive (GDELT) or are stamped 'live index, cut-off X'.
